"""Shipping quotes."""

ZONE_SURCHARGE = {"eu": 4.0, "na": 6.5, "apac": 9.0}


def domestic_quote(parcel):
    weight = max(parcel["weight_kg"], 0.1)
    volume = parcel["length"] * parcel["width"] * parcel["height"] / 5000
    billable = max(weight, volume)
    base = 4.50 + 1.20 * billable
    if parcel.get("fragile"):
        base += 2.00
    surcharge = 0.0
    total = round(base + surcharge, 2)
    return {"billable_kg": round(billable, 2), "price": total, "currency": "USD"}


def international_quote(parcel, zone):
    weight = max(parcel["weight_kg"], 0.1)
    volume = parcel["length"] * parcel["width"] * parcel["height"] / 5000
    billable = max(weight, volume)
    base = 9.00 + 3.10 * billable
    if parcel.get("fragile"):
        base += 2.00
    if billable > 2:
        surcharge = ZONE_SURCHARGE.get(zone, 12.0)
    else:
        surcharge = 0.0
    total = round(base + surcharge, 2)
    return {"billable_kg": round(billable, 2), "price": total, "currency": "USD"}
